name: Eucharist The Lords Supper
overview: The Lord's Supper, or Eucharist, is instituted by Christ during the Passover feast as a profound act of remembrance and proclamation of His sacrificial death. Jesus took bread and the cup, declaring the bread as His body given for believers and the cup as the new covenant in His blood, emphasizing the necessity of remembering His sacrifice (Matthew 26:17; Mark 14:22; Luke 22:19-20). This sacred meal not only recalls Christ's atoning work but also reveals His enduring love for His followers, as He prepared them for His departure and the new covenant relationship with the Father (John 13:1).
